def solution():
    # Define loan amounts and terms
    home_price = 500_000
    first_principal = home_price * 0.80
    second_principal = home_price * 0.10

    # Calculate monthly principal-and-interest payments
    first_rate = 0.035 / 12
    first_months = 30 * 12
    first_payment = first_principal * first_rate / (1 - (1 + first_rate) ** -first_months)

    second_rate = 0.06 / 12
    second_months = 15 * 12
    second_payment = second_principal * second_rate / (1 - (1 + second_rate) ** -second_months)

    # Return the combined payment, rounded to the nearest dollar
    return round(first_payment + second_payment)
